note: Class ids from mindustry.gen.EntityMapping.idMap; names from its nameMap (unit types and other names that map to the class). writeSync is the entity snapshot layout (after i32 id, u8 class id); write is the save/world stream layout (after u8 class id, i32 id), starting with its i16 revision. ops are in wire order: 'field' is the field written, 'codec' the call that writes it; 'loop' marks per-element writes.
